(i) That is, covered with plates of gold.

(a) Read 2Sa 6:12.

(b) When the things were dedicated and brought into the temple. (c) Called in Hebrew Ethanim, containing part of September and part of October, 1Ki 8:2, which moves the Jews called the first month, because they say that the world was created in that month, and after they came from Egypt, they began at March: but because this opinion is uncertain, we always make March the first as the best writers do.

(d) For Aaron's rod and manna were taken from there before it was brought to this place.
